home.title: Home details
home.description: The home's name, where it is, its language, and the electricity price behind the energy costs.

backup.title: Backup
backup.description: Keep a copy of your home's setup, and bring it back on a new server.

export.title: Download a backup
export.description: Floors with their plans, rooms, integrations, devices, their places on the plans and the accounts (without passwords).
export.secretsHelp: Sign-ins and tokens go in encrypted with a passphrase. Without them, integrations ask for their credentials again after a restore.
export.passphraseHelp: At least {min} characters. You'll need it to restore the credentials; it can't be recovered.

problems.required: Enter a passphrase to include the credentials.

export.doneWithSecrets: Backup downloaded, with the credentials encrypted. Keep the passphrase somewhere safe.

import.title: Restore a backup
import.description: Brings a backup into a new, empty home: everything comes back as it was saved.
import.notEmpty: Restoring works only on a fresh install: set up the new server, then restore the backup there.
import.notZip: That isn't a backup file. Choose the .zip that ControlHome downloaded.
import.passphraseHelp: Only if the backup includes the integrations' credentials.
import.secretsBack: The integrations' credentials came back too; they're starting now.
import.secretsMissing: The backup had no credentials: sign each integration in again from its page.
import.usersNote: No accounts were added | The restored account has no password yet: set one in Users. | The {n} restored accounts have no password yet: set one for each in Users.

daily.title: Automatic backups
daily.description: The server writes a backup without credentials every day and keeps the last {keep}.
daily.failed: The last automatic backup failed ({time}). Check that the server has free space, then back up now.
daily.none: No automatic backup yet. The first one is written within a day.
daily.noCredentials: They don't include credentials; copy them somewhere safe now and then.

history.title: Data retention
history.description: How long ControlHome keeps what your devices did. Keeping more means a bigger database.

stateLogDays.label: Every change
stateLogDays.help: Each value as it changed: charts of the last few hours.

shortTermStatsDays.label: 5-minute averages
shortTermStatsDays.help: With their lows and highs: charts of up to a week.

deviceEventDays.label: Button presses and other events
deviceEventDays.help: Momentary events such as a press or a doorbell ring.

auditLogDays.label: Audit log
auditLogDays.help: Who did what: sign-ins, settings, safety actions.

history.range: Use a whole number of days from {min} to {max}.

problems.shortBelowRaw: Keep 5-minute averages at least as long as every change ({days}).
